decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-8ff725c31bf6], is a one-line changelog entry that links to PR 10308. It doesn't say which environments are exposed: it gives no tracing configuration, component or query path, and no threshold for what makes a trace "small". It also doesn't say what "elide" means in practice, for example whether spans are dropped or merged. To write the applicability condition, we need the PR description or docs that state when this behavior applies and what is no longer emitted.
